νάρκισσ-ος , ὁ, rarely ἡ, Theoc. 1.133 :—
A.narcissus, of various species, h.Cer. 8 , 428 , S. OC 683 (lyr.), Mosch. 2.65 ; pheasant's eye, Narcissus poeticus, Thphr. HP 6.8.1 , Dsc. 4.158 ; autumn narcissus, N. serotinus, Thphr. HP 6.6.9 ; Narcissus Tazetta, polyanthus narcissus, Dsc.l.c. (this prob. in S. l.c.). (Connected with νάρκη, because of its narcotic properties, acc. to Plu. 2.647b .)
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
